description:
Predict a single match: most likely scoreline + outcome probabilities.

Args:
    home_team: First team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "ESP" or "Spain").
    away_team: Second team, FIFA code or name.
    neutral: True for a neutral venue (World Cup default).

Returns:
    data: {most_likely_score, home_win, draw, away_win, predicted_winner}.
    meta.estimated: true.

away_team.description: Second team, FIFA code or name.
away_team.title: Away Team

home_team.description: First team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "ESP" or "Spain").
home_team.title: Home Team

neutral.description: True for a neutral venue (World Cup default).
neutral.title: Neutral

name: football_match_predictor
